meta.title: MIRANIMA — Your expression shouldn’t have to bend to your tools.
meta.description: MIRANIMA is a software brand from Japan that designs tools around what makers want to express. We develop NIARIM, a hand-drawn animation app for Android.
meta.ogDescription: Tools designed around what makers want to express. The software brand behind NIARIM, a hand-drawn animation app.

hero.title: Your expression shouldn’t have to bend to your tools.
hero.lead: What you want to draw, and how you make it, is different for everyone. Rather than asking makers to work around their tools, MIRANIMA designs tools starting from what they want to express.
hero.detail: We turn the “if only it could…” moments of real creative work into software you can actually use. Our first product is NIARIM, a hand-drawn animation app.

mirror.aria: A canvas showing the MIRANIMA symbol, drawn symmetrically around a central axis. Anything drawn on it is mirrored onto the opposite side.
mirror.hintFine: Drag to draw. Every line is mirrored onto the other side.
mirror.hintTouch: Tap “Draw” and trace with your finger. Every line is mirrored onto the other side.

name.title: Two meanings in one name.
name.figcaption: The name MIRANIMA can be read two ways: MIRROR + ANIMA, and MIRAI + ANIMATION.
name.m1Title: A mirror for what’s inside the maker.
name.m1Text: Anima is a word for soul, or life. We want to make tools that work like a mirror, reflecting a creator’s sensibility and the images in their mind exactly as they intend. Tools that don’t decide how you should express yourself, but take in what you have in mind.
name.m2Title: Shaping the future of expression, together.
name.m2Text: Mirai is the Japanese word for “future”. Animation means giving movement — breathing life into something. Through the tools we make, we want to support people who try new ways of creating and new forms of expression. That wish is in the name, too.

product.tagline: Draw it frame by frame. Bring it to life.
product.lead: NIARIM is an Android app for making hand-drawn animation on your phone or tablet.
product.body: Draw on the canvas, lay the next frame over it, and refine the motion as you play it back. From drawing and editing to audio and video export, the whole process happens in one app.

flip.title: A bouncing ball animation
flip.caption: A bouncing ball, one frame at a time. Turn on onion skin to see the frames before and after.
